answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the mirror of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, converted to a slow vesting stream.
